summary_en: M3 announced a plan to acquire treasury shares through both open tender offer and market purchases. The disclosure outlines the company's approach and considerations regarding the buyback program.
title_en: Acquisition of Treasury Shares and Open Tender Offer for Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On November 20, 2026, M3, Inc. announced plans to acquire treasury shares using two methods: a formal open tender offer and direct market purchases. This disclosure document outlines the company's objectives and framework for the buyback program. The document serves as an informational resource explaining M3's approach to the treasury share acquisition rather than as a solicitation for participation. Investors considering participation in the tender offer are directed to review the formal tender offer prospectus separately before making investment decisions.
